Privacy Policy

This privacy policy applies to the Jelly Jams app (available here) and the Jelly Jams Backend (available here).
These two applications run only on your devices with absolutely no related services run by me, Patrick Coffey.


Information Collection and Use

Neither Jelly Jams nor the Jelly Jams Backend collect any information whatsoever. Nothing about you, your device, or anything like that is collected by the applications or me in any way.

Jell Jams connects to your Jellyfin Server and, optionally, to your instance of the Jelly Jams Backend. Both of those server applications would be under your control, and are not run by me.
The Jelly Jams Backend application connects to your Jellyfin server and an instance of AudioMuse-AI that it sets up. All of these applications would be run by you, within your network with nothing about any of them ever coming to more or any server/application that I control.

Residents of many jurisdictions (eg. California, the EU) have the right to request any data held about them. In this case, I collect literally no information at all. So inquires like this will be answered confirming that I don't collect anything and linking you to this policy.

For inquires you can e-mail jellyjams@coffey.app.

Changes

I may need to update this Privacy Policy in the future. I expect this to mostly be adding boiler plate related to newly enacted privacy legislation in various regions, confirming that I do not collect process or transmit any information about my users. But the policy is tracked on GitHub here where you can see a complete history of any changes ever made to it from embarassing typos like spelling "application" wrong to wording changes. The substance of the policy has always remained the same; I do not collect data.

However, in the event that I begin to track any information at all, eg adding some kind of analytics or crash detections, all users will be notified well in advance of such a change and given a specific date upon which the collection of such data shall begin. I have no plans to ever do this, this section only exists so that I can say that in the event of such a change I'll make a serious effort to let any user of my application know all about well in advance of anything actually being done.

Final Summary

Jelly Jams is a music playing app that connects to your Jellyfin server and serves your own files back to you. The Jelly Jams Backend is a companion service that tries to add some smart playlist generation features to Jellyfin. No data of any kind is collected by me.
Check out the source code on GitHub for Jelly Jams and Jelly Jams Backend to see everything they can do.
